text:
Maria (Product): FYI — incoming feature ask from StrataHealth via Ajay: they want a way for their SREs to drill into request-level telemetry from the Console and see a billable-unit breakdown (tokens vs embeddings) alongside a link to the request trace. Can we triage?
Sam (Support): pasted ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/8472 (customer provided examples + CSV export). Key ask lines: "we need trace links tied to user requests in the UI" and "show cost split per-path so we can chargeback to product teams"
Ajay (Sales): customer is willing to sign a 12m commitment if we ship visibility within ~8 weeks. They said this is blocking procurement. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Priya (Engineering): quick clarifying q's: 1) do they need live trace linking (trace-id in UI) or just sample-based links? 2) billing split — is this aggregated per-route or per-API-key + route? Both change how we tag ingress.
Derek (Analytics): MVP idea: offline aggregation job that computes per-route token_count, embed_count, and cost_estimate from usage logs (daily). UI tile can show last-30d and let user click to see top 100 requests. Trace links: add url template that includes trace_id when available; trace_id exists on ~10% sampled requests today.
Maria (Product): Proposed MVP launch criteria (draft):
• Surface: Console tile showing per-service/path totals (tokens, embed ops, est. cost) for selected window.
• Drillthrough: clickable row -> list of sampled requests with a trace link when trace_id present.
• Accuracy: aggregated token/embed counts match billing within 2% after first-week backfill.
• Security: only show data for org-scoped API keys; respect RBAC.
• Rollout: feature flag + telemetry opt-in for customers who want trace linking.
Would those be acceptable?
Priya (Engineering): those look reasonable. Implementation notes: need a) a new ingestion tag (billing_tag) at gateway to guarantee attribution, b) a daily aggregation pipeline + backfill for last 90 days, c) UI endpoints. Rough estimate: backend 6-8 dev-weeks, UI 2-3 dev-weeks, analytics/job 2 dev-weeks (can overlap).
Zoe (Design): Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/telemetry-drilldown (mocked tiles + compact drillthrough). I can trim to a single compact panel for console home.
Ajay (Sales): can we offer a phased commitment? Customer ok with beta access + contractual milestone on visibility. I can confirm firm commitment if we get a ship date in next 3 weeks.
Maria (Product): Prioritization question: do we treat as sales-driven high-pri (if Ajay confirms ELA) or backlog-incremental? My suggested flow: if Ajay confirms contract, push to Q2 sprint 1 and schedule a pre-alpha with StrataHealth. Otherwise, mark P2 and queue for next planning. Thoughts?
Derek (Analytics): quick-win option: create a "Billing Insights" saved query in Data Explorer that joins usage table with token estimates. No infra changes required; gives customer immediate visibility while we build. I can prototype a dashboard tile in 3 days.
Priya (Engineering): Agree with Derek for short-term. Long-term we need the billing_tag and a trace propagation check (gateway -> worker -> trace system). Also need to note possible perf impact for synchronous tagging.
Sam (Support): Customer also asked for CSV export of per-route breakdown. Likely trivial once we have aggregation table.
Maria (Product): Action items:
• Ajay: confirm contract/ELA by EOD Wed (owner: Ajay).
• Derek: prototype saved-query + dashboard tile (3d).
• Priya: spike to validate trace-id propagation + estimate backend work (5d).
• Zoe: narrow Figma to 1 panel + sample copy (4d).
• Maria: create feature ticket with MVP criteria and dependencies, tag sales-driven if Ajay confirms.
console-bot: NOTE created ticket RW-3821 (feature/billing-visibility) assigned to Maria.
Ajay (Sales): confirmed — I have verbal ok, will send signed LOI if we get a clear ship plan. :thumbsup:
Maria (Product): Ok — setting follow-up sync Thursday 10am. If Ajay sends LOI before then we'll move to sales-priority lane. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
